name: WARNING: Dunkin' Refreshers (Strawberry Dragonfruit / Mango Pineapple)
whyItWorks: Made with fruit juice concentrates, high citric acid, green tea caffeine extract, and B-vitamins. High acidity inflames mucosal linings and can trigger acid reflux and loose stools.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip Refreshers. Drink plain iced herbal tea or bottled room-temperature water.
